description: This file defines the Cheque payment method model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides functionality to determine if the Cheque payment method should be available based on configuration and customer address, and returns the method data for use in checkout.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Model class handling the Cheque payment method logic, including availability checks based on configuration, address, and geo-zones.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns available payment method data if conditions based on configuration and geo-zones are satisfied, otherwise returns an empty array.
